basis.governing_question: How can Vale Verde reduce the treated water lost to network leaks, through a program piloted in two districts and then rolled out?

sub_questions.question: Where and why does the network lose treated water, and how much?
Which leak-detection routine and loss-reduction program should the two pilot districts test?
Do water losses in the two pilot districts fall below their pre-pilot level?
How do all remaining districts come to run the new leak-detection routine by the end of the rollout?
Do water losses stay lower and the routine stay in use across all districts after rollout?

work.unit: Site diagnosed on the floor (cost baseline, line observation, loss analysis)

phase_work.why: Three representative districts diagnosed two at a time, the rest extended from data; the maximum exceeds typical 3-6 weeks because the sample takes two rounds.

work.unit: Loss-reduction program and leak-detection routine designed
Pilot plan and loss baseline for each pilot district

phase_work.why: Routine design comes first, then one pilot plan covering both districts together; the archetype has no Design phase to compare against.

work.unit: Leak-detection routine set up and crews briefed in a pilot district
Live run in a pilot district with losses tracked against baseline

phase_work.why: Both pilot districts run side by side: set-up, then a live run with losses tracked; phase not in the archetype, so weeks are estimated.

work.unit: Rollout wave of up to 3 sites

phase_work.why: Six districts remain after the pilot, rolled out in two waves of three, one wave at a time.

work.unit: Water losses tracked in all districts against the pre-pilot baseline

phase_work.why: Losses tracked in all districts for 4-5 weeks, then one client review; phase not in the archetype, so weeks are estimated.

sizing.levers: Running two rollout waves side by side, or diagnosing two representative districts instead of three, would shorten the engagement most.

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where and why Vale Verde loses treated water in its network and set the loss baseline.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Which loss causes and districts should the program design target?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the loss-reduction program and leak-detection routine, and plan the pilot in the two pilot districts.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Approve the program design and go ahead with the pilot in two districts?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Run the new leak-detection routine in two districts and show whether their water losses fall below pre-pilot levels.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Go or no-go on rolling the routine out to the remaining districts?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the leak-detection routine to the remaining districts so every district runs it by the end.

gate.label: Rollout sign-off
gate.decision: Accept the rollout as complete and start measuring results in all districts?

phases.name: Measurement
phases.objective_one_line: Track water losses against the pre-pilot baseline and the success criteria across all districts after rollout.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the measured loss results and close the engagement?

architect_notes: Phase lengths follow the brief's stage lengths (6, 6, 8, 13, 6) and sum to 39; the work estimates total 31-43 weeks.
District count is assumed at 8 (6 after the pilot); each extra rollout wave of three adds 4-6 weeks, so confirm it.
Diagnostic holds only if 3 representative districts are sampled; the work estimates at 6-8 weeks against the stated 6.
Archetype performance_improvement has only Diagnostic and Implementation, so Design, Pilot and Measurement are added because the brief names them.
